Here, I revisit this critical issue and review new experimental evidences that tighten the link between dopamine activity and RPE. First, I introduce the recent observation of a gradual backward shift of dopamine activity that had eluded researchers for over a decade. I also discuss several other findings, such as dopamine ramping, that were initially interpreted to conflict but later found to be consistent with RPE.
